changelog:
- Initial release of the Email Sequence skill.
- Generates multi-email nurture, onboarding, launch, or re-engagement sequences with a mapped goal and trigger for each email.
- Produces sequence overview (map: trigger, timing, goal per email) and full copy (subject, preview, body, CTA) for every email.
- Includes clear quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure effective, single-goal emails and avoid common mistakes.
- Defines required inputs and output format to streamline sequence creation for various campaign types.
